draft.subject: A quick first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Good to see you've already brought a teammate into Wrenfield. The next natural step is your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so once one exists the rest falls into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if that's easiest.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to sit with you while you set up that first project and get a few real tasks in with your teammate.

Best,
Nadia
